Our analyses show that these gains are not only quantitative: relative to general-purpose multilingual models, MameLoshnLM better captures language-defining lexical and morphological patterns, pointing to a broader failure mode of noisy web-scale multilingual data for low-resource languages. Our results provide both a foundation for Yiddish NLP and a practical template for language model development in historically rich but digitally underrepresented languages.

</details>


### [155] [Mapping Similarity Spaces across Embedding Models with Synthetic Query Probing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05857)
*Marcin Rozmus,Peter van der Putten*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出Synthetic Query Probing（SQP）方法，通过从文档生成查询来创建受控的查询-块配对，在不依赖参考嵌入的情况下学习不同嵌入模型间相似度分数的映射关系，从而提升阈值在不同模型间的可移植性。实验表明，虽然不同嵌入模型在排序上大致一致，但绝对分数存在系统性失真，其中等渗回归（isotonic regression）在分数转换和对齐方面表现最佳。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）系统依赖相似度分数检索相关内容，但不同嵌入模型因几何属性不同，其分数不可直接比较，导致模型迁移困难且阈值无法复用，需要一种可扩展的方法来建立跨模型分数空间之间的映射关系。

Method: 提出Synthetic Query Probing（SQP）框架：从文档自动生成查询，构造受控的查询-块配对，从而无需参考嵌入即可在大规模上进行跨模型相似度行为分析。使用线性回归、等渗回归（isotonic regression）和分位数映射（quantile mapping）三种方法学习分数转换函数。

Result: 在SciFact和专有语料库上的实验表明：不同嵌入模型在排序上表现高度一致，但绝对分数存在系统性失真；学习得到的映射函数能够部分对齐分数空间并提升阈值的可移植性，其中等渗回归效果最佳。

Conclusion: 跨模型校准对RAG系统至关重要，SQP可作为分析嵌入可比性的可扩展框架，为embedding模型迁移中的阈值复用和分数对齐提供了有效方案。

Abstract: Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems rely on similarity scores to retrieve relevant content, yet scores are not directly comparable across embedding models due to differing geometric properties, complicating model migration and limiting threshold reuse. We study how similarity scores can be related by learning mappings between score distributions rather than embeddings. We introduce Synthetic Query Probing, generating queries from documents to create controlled query-chunk pairs, enabling large-scale, reference-free analysis of cross-model similarity behavior. We evaluate the approach on multiple embedding configurations and learn score conversion functions using linear, isotonic, and quantile mappings. Experiments on SciFact and a proprietary corpus show that while models largely agree on rankings, their absolute scores exhibit systematic distortions. Learned mappings partially align these spaces and improve threshold portability, with isotonic regression performing best. Our results highlight the need for cross-model calibration and position Synthetic Query Probing as a scalable framework for analyzing embedding comparability.

</details>


### [156] [MACRO: Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05872)
*Paweł Batorski,Abtin Pourhadi,Akylgali Aitaza,Przemysław Spurek,Paul Swoboda*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: MACRO是一个无需修改底层权重即可学习任务特定Transformer层路由路径的框架。它通过马尔可夫策略对层路由进行建模，支持层重复、跳过和残差状态添加操作，并使用top-k Viterbi算法解码路由。在多个开放权重LLM和推理/知识基准上，MACRO相比未路由基线平均提升+5.0%准确率，相比最佳动态路由方法Dr. LLM提升+7.2%，同时将路由搜索时间从14.8小时降至1.6小时（9.4x加速）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM按顺序执行所有层，但动态层路由（如层重复、跳过等）可以提升性能。然而现有路由方法面临三大挑战：需要更新模型权重、每个测试实例需要昂贵的搜索循环、或在推理时需要ground-truth标签。作者旨在提出一种不修改底层参数、无实例级搜索、无需推理标签的轻量级路由框架。

Method: MACRO将层路由建模为上下文相关的马尔可夫策略，其条件包括：层索引、计算预算阶段、方向位移和操作符上下文。支持的动态路由操作包括跳过（skip）、重复（repeat）和残差隐藏状态添加。路由分布通过训练数据上的反馈信号进行更新，推理时使用top-k Viterbi算法解码出高概率的候选路由程序。

Result: 在多个开放权重LLM和多种推理/知识基准上，MACRO相比未路由基线平均提升+5.0%准确率，小模型上增益最大。相比最优动态路由方法Dr. LLM，MACRO提升+7.2%准确率，并将路由搜索时间从14.8小时压缩至1.6小时，达到9.4倍加速。

Conclusion: MACRO证明了无需修改模型参数即可实现高效、任务特定的LLM动态层路由，既提升了准确率又大幅降低了路由搜索开销。该框架在小型模型上收益最为显著，且代码已开源。

Abstract: Standard Large Language Models (LLMs) execute layers sequentially. Dynamic layer routing, i.e. search for a different execution path through layers involving layer repetitions, skips and other moves, can improve performance. Existing routing approaches often require updating model weights, running expensive search loops per test instance, or demand ground-truth labels during inference. In this work, we propose Markov Chain Routing of Transformer Layers (MACRO), a framework that learns task-specific routes over LLM architectures without modifying underlying parameters. MACRO models layer routing as a context-dependent Markov policy conditioned on layer indices, computation budget phases, directional displacements, and operator context, supporting skip, repeat, and residual hidden-state addition operations. The Markov route distribution is updated via feedback on training data and decoded using a top-k Viterbi algorithm to isolate high-probability candidate programs. We evaluate MACRO across diverse reasoning and knowledge benchmarks on multiple open-weight LLMs. MACRO achieves a +5.0% average accuracy improvement over the unrouted baselines, with largest gains on small models. We outperform the best dynamic routing approach Dr. LLM by +7.2%, while reducing route-search time 9.4x (from 14.8 to 1.6 hours). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/MACRO.

</details>


### [157] [Causal Episodic Memory for Feedback-Driven Agent Repair](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05906)
*Khang Nhat Hoang Vo,Tam Minh Chu,Anh Trac Duc Dinh,Thuyen Vinh Ha Bui,Tho Quan*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出MERIT，一种无需训练的Text-to-SQL修复智能体，通过维护在线双极性记忆（包含oracle验证的正向修正和失败方向）来提升后续episode的修复效率。在Spider和BIRD基准上分别将执行准确率从66.34%提升到69.79%、从47.35%提升到48.44%，但增益的统计显著性因数据集而异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在修复失败时往往丢弃已验证成功的修正方案，导致后续episode需要重复探索相似解法，造成推理资源浪费和修复效率低下。

Method: MERIT维护一个在线双极性记忆库，存储oracle验证过的成功修正和观察到的失败方向。在oracle辅助基准反馈下，仅允许检索先前已完成episode的记忆。一个确定性分类器分配粗粒度失败类型，用于条件化混合词法-稠密检索器，随后冻结模型生成每次修订。整个流程无需参数更新。

Result: 使用Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct并在相同初始预测和修复预算下，MERIT在Spider上将执行准确率从66.34%提升至69.79%，在BIRD上从47.35%提升至48.44%。配对分析显示Spider上的提升有强证据，但BIRD上的证据较弱。MERIT在两种基准上均未与无类型动态检索形成可靠区分；Reflexion式记忆在BIRD上达到51.24%但推理成本显著更高。消融实验表明负向记忆贡献有限，类型条件和词法-稠密排序的价值因数据集而异，schema局部经验提供最一致的收益。

Conclusion: 因果跨查询记忆（即仅使用已完成episode的经验）对Text-to-SQL修复的提升效果因数据集和条件而异。研究阐明了何时该种记忆表示有优势，何时更广泛的记忆表示仍更可取。

Abstract: LLM agents that repair failures often discard successful corrections, forcing later episodes to rediscover similar solutions. We study whether finalized repair outcomes can improve subsequent Text-to-SQL episodes without parameter updates. We introduce MERIT, a training-free agent that maintains an online dual-polarity memory of oracle-verified corrections and observed unsuccessful directions. Under oracle-assisted benchmark feedback, only memories from earlier finalized episodes are eligible for retrieval. A deterministic classifier assigns a coarse failure type, which conditions a hybrid lexical-dense retriever before the frozen model generates each revision. Using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct with identical initial predictions and repair budgets, MERIT improves execution accuracy over stateless iterative repair from \(66.34\%\) to \(69.79\%\) on Spider and from \(47.35\%\) to \(48.44\%\) on BIRD. Paired analyses provide clear evidence for the Spider gain but weaker evidence on BIRD. MERIT is not reliably separated from untyped dynamic retrieval on either benchmark, while Reflexion-style memory reaches \(51.24\%\) on BIRD at substantially higher inference cost. Ablations show that negative memory contributes modestly, the value of type conditioning and lexical--dense ranking is dataset dependent, and schema-local experience provides the most consistent benefit. These results clarify when causal cross-query memory improves repair and when broader memory representations remain preferable.

</details>


### [158] [Clinical Communication Processing with Models Trained on LLM-Generated Synthetic Data: A Structured Survey and Novel Application Case Studies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05993)
*Alexander Apartsin,Yehudit Aperstein*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出利用大语言模型将结构化临床数据（如病历、诊断标签、症状列表、护理计划）转换为合成临床沟通文本（如对话、交接报告、分诊记录），以在缺乏真实标注数据的情况下引导构建临床NLP系统。作者通过结构化叙事综述和13个新型案例研究展示了该方法在不同沟通渠道和语言中的有效性，并指出现有研究大多仅在合成数据上评估，真实数据迁移验证仍有限。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 临床信息大量存在于自然语言沟通中（病人描述症状、医生推理指导、救护车交接、护士换班汇报），而非仅结构化记录。这类语言依赖说话者角色、意图、因果关系、不确定性和遗漏等语境信息，与表格数据本质不同。然而，真实临床对话具有隐私性、碎片化且标注成本高昂，导致高质量标注语料稀缺，阻碍了医疗NLP的发展。合成临床沟通数据被认为是一种可行的替代路径。

Method: 作者采用结构化叙事综述方法，从四个维度组织文献：（1）源表示形式（source representation）、（2）沟通形式与参与者（communication form and participants）、（3）生成方法（generation method）、（4）下游任务（downstream task）。同时补充13个新型案例研究，在无真实标注数据的条件下构建临床NLP系统，覆盖EMS预到达报告、战场无线电伤员文档、护士交接、患者门户分诊和低资源出院沟通等场景，并对比微调编码器模型与零样本基线。

Result: 合成临床沟通能够有效引导构建临床NLP系统。案例研究表明：在零样本基线上，微调的编码器模型表现具有竞争力；刻意引入的降质（degraded）沟通数据对系统鲁棒性有价值。主要局限是大多数研究仅在保留的合成通信数据上进行评估，而"合成训练、真实测试"的证据仍然有限。

Conclusion: 合成临床沟通正逐渐成为实用的研究资源，但要使其成为可复用的临床基础设施，仍需真实数据迁移验证、安全性和外部验证的支撑。未来研究方向应聚焦于从合成数据训练转向真实临床数据的泛化能力评估。

Abstract: Much clinical value is conveyed not through structured records but through communication: exchanges in which patients describe symptoms, clinicians reason and give instructions, ambulances hand over to emergency departments, and nurses pass on a shift. Such language differs from tabular data because meaning depends on speaker role, intent, causality, uncertainty, omission, and channel noise. Healthcare natural language processing must therefore interpret information as conveyed rather than coded. This requires well-annotated corpora, which are scarce because authentic exchanges are private, fragmented, and costly to annotate. Large language models offer a way forward by transforming clinical sources, such as records, diagnostic labels, symptom lists, or care plans, into written and transcribed communication for downstream models. We present a structured narrative survey organized by source representation, communication form and participants, generation method, and downstream task, complemented by thirteen novel case studies. These build clinical NLP systems for communication channels and languages without labeled real-world data, including EMS pre-arrival reports, field-radio casualty documentation, nurse handoffs, patient-portal triage, and low-resource discharge communication. They show that synthetic communication can bootstrap such systems. Findings include the competitiveness of fine-tuned encoder models over evaluated zero-shot baselines and the value of deliberately degraded communication for robustness. The main limitation is that most studies evaluate on held-out synthetic communication, while train-on-synthetic, test-on-authentic evidence remains limited. We conclude that syn-thetic clinical communication is becoming a practical research resource; establishing it as reusable clinical infrastructure will require authentic-data transfer, safety and external validation.

</details>


### [159] [FormBharo: Designing and Evaluating a Voice Agent for Conversational Form Filling in Rural India](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06027)
*Aman Dalmia,Sanskriti Midha,Jigar Doshi*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: FormBharo是一个为印度低识字率人群设计的语音代理系统，将LLM与确定性规则校验结合，通过电话通话填写结构化福利申请表格。该系统正与NGO组织ARMMAN合作试点，用于为低收入的印地语母亲提供母婴保健注册服务。论文发布FormVoiceAgentBench基准（包含960次模拟呼叫、3,760个多轮对话测试），并发现组件性能不能预测端到端性能，需通过端到端评估选择最优模型配置。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 印度几乎所有的社会福利申请都需要填写表格，但最需要这些福利的人群往往不识字。现有的解决方案依赖一线卫生工作者逐一为受益人办理登记，严重浪费了本已紧张的资源。因此需要通过语音对话来帮助这些人群完成表格填写，但现有语音代理在低延迟、低成本约束下完成结构化表格填写的能力尚未得到充分验证。

Method: FormBharo将LLM与确定性、基于规则的验证和流程控制相结合，在电话通话中实现结构化表格填写。研究团队开发了FormVoiceAgentBench基准，将人工录制的印地语音频与960次模拟呼叫中的3,760个多轮对话测试配对，用以评估系统组件（转录、信息提取、回复生成）及端到端表格完成效果。此外使用基于Pareto的加权和标量化方法，在准确性、成本和延迟三者之间选择最优的可部署配置。

Result: 当LLM接收有错误的真实语音转录而非参考转录时，表格完成率最多下降约41个百分点。基于规则的流程控制能够恢复许多轮次级别的提取错误，使较小的、更便宜的模型在表格完成上达到或超过前沿模型。组件性能无法预测端到端性能：GPT-5.5在参考转录上的轮次级别提取准确率领先（99.8%），但在表格完成上排名较低。没有单一模型能在准确性、成本和延迟三方面同时最优，需通过端到端评估选择配置。

Conclusion: 错误在流水线中既会传播也会相互抵消，因此最优模型选择只能通过端到端评估来确定；组件级别的性能指标不足以指导模型选型。实践上需通过多目标权衡（Pareto分析加加权和标量化）来平衡准确性、成本和延迟，选出可部署的配置。

Abstract: In India, almost every social benefit starts with a form, yet the people who need these benefits most are often unable to read or write. Reaching them requires a spoken conversation. Today that work falls to frontline health workers who enroll beneficiaries one at a time, a poor use of stretched capacity. We built FormBharo ("fill the form" in Hindi), a voice agent that fills a structured form over a phone call under tight latency and cost budgets by pairing Large Language Models (LLMs) with deterministic, rule-based validation and flow control. It is being piloted with ARMMAN, an NGO running large-scale maternal and child mobile-health programs in India, to enroll low-income, Hindi-speaking mothers in antenatal and postnatal care. To our knowledge, it is the first voice agent piloted to fill an enrollment form for this population. We openly release FormVoiceAgentBench, a benchmark pairing human-recorded Hindi audio with 3,760 multi-turn conversation tests across 960 simulated calls, to evaluate our agent's components (transcription, extraction, reply generation) and end-to-end form completion under real acoustic variations. Form completion drops by up to ~41 points when LLMs receive error-prone real-speech transcripts instead of reference ones. The rule-based controls recover many turn-level extraction errors, helping smaller, cheaper models match or surpass frontier models on form completion. Component performance does not predict end-to-end performance: GPT-5.5 leads turn-level extraction accuracy on reference transcripts (99.8%) but ranks lower on form completion. Since errors both propagate and cancel across the pipeline, the optimal model choice of models emerges only through end-to-end evaluation. Finally, no single model is best across accuracy, cost, and latency at once, so we use a Pareto-based weighted-sum scalarization to select a deployable configuration balancing the three.

</details>


### [160] [Training-Free Token-Level Steering for LLM Personalized Co-Writing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06069)
*Wenhao Mao,Chengbin Hou,Weixiao Wang,Jialiang Zhu,Min Liu,Yibin Hao,Hairong Lv*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: SteerWrite是一个无需训练的个性化协同写作框架，通过无梯度更新方式将基础大语言模型适配到专业领域，在小数据集上实现最先进性能，显著减少人工编辑工作量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在个性化任务上虽有潜力，但缺乏专业领域知识。传统微调方法计算成本高且难以应对快速数据更新，检索增强生成无法提供细粒度的token级引导，且现有界面仍以聊天为主，协同写作范式在代码领域之外尚未被充分利用。

Method: SteerWrite是一个训练免费（training-free）框架，专为个性化协同写作设计。它无需梯度更新即可将基础模型适配到专业领域，并针对小数据集进行了特定设计优化。

Result: 在多种数据集、指标和模型上的实验表明，SteerWrite达到了最先进的性能，并显著减少了人工编辑工作量。

Conclusion: SteerWrite通过免训练的方式有效解决了LLM个性化写作中领域知识缺失的问题，提供了一种低成本、高适应性的个性化协同写作解决方案。

Abstract: While Large Language Models (LLMs) show great promise for personalization, they often lack specialized domain knowledge. Conventional solutions like fine-tuning struggle with high computational costs and rapid data updates, while Retrieval-Augmented Generation fails to provide fine-grained, token-level steering. Furthermore, chat-based interfaces remain dominant, whereas productive co-writing paradigms have not yet been well exploited beyond the coding domain. To this end, we introduce SteerWrite, a training-free framework designed for personalized co-writing. Our method effectively adapts the base model to specialized domains without gradient updates, with specific designs tailored to small datasets. Experiments demonstrate that SteerWrite achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse datasets, metrics, and models, significantly reducing human editing effort.

</details>


### [161] [Beyond Sequence Order: Syntax-Informed Positional Embeddings for Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06111)
*Haris Riaz,Hyungji Kim,Mihai Surdeanu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出SiPE（语法感知位置编码），在预训练阶段从依存句法树中学习轻量级句法先验，并将其注入到绝对、相对、旋转三种主流位置编码家族中，在不改动自注意力机制和其余架构的前提下，同时提升句法泛化能力（SyntaxGym最高+10.3%）和真实语言理解能力（GLUE最高+8.2%），并降低困惑度（-9.0%）。与现有需要在推理时对多个句法树求和或丢弃语法的模型不同，SiPE只需单个句法树，在句法监督与推理成本之间建立了新的帕累托最优前沿。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的位置编码主要编码token之间的距离和顺序，却基本忽略了句法结构信息。虽然已有多种句法注入方法，但大多数要么在推理时需要边缘化众多句法树导致计算开销大，要么在运行时丢弃语法信息，且现有的句法注入方法往往以牺牲语言建模性能（困惑度）为代价。因此需要一种既能注入句法知识、又不增加推理成本、还能不损伤甚至提升下游性能的轻量级句法感知位置编码方案。

Method: SiPE在预训练阶段从依存句法解析中学习一个轻量句法先验，并注入到三大主流位置编码家族（绝对、相对、旋转）中，适用于编码器和解码器，且不改变自注意力机制和其余架构。作者系统地隔离了句法先验应当注入的“位置”（输入嵌入、自注意力、位置项与注意力项联合）和“方式”（加法或乘法耦合），发现：(1) 对使用相对位置编码的自回归解码器，将句法先验与注意力分数中的相对位置项做乘法耦合效果最强；(2) 对编码器，直接将句法先验加到输入嵌入中效果最佳。推理时仅对单一依存句法树进行条件化。

Result: 在SyntaxGym基准上最多提升10.3%，同时在无句法监督的基础模型上困惑度降低9.0%（这一指标是几乎所有现有句法注入方法都会退化的）。在GLUE基准上最多提升8.2%，表明句法先验不仅能提升句法泛化，还能改善真实语言理解。与需要在推理时对众多句法树进行边缘化或运行时丢弃句法的模型相比，SiPE仅需单个句法树即可取得更优效果，建立了句法监督与推理成本之间的新帕累托前沿。

Conclusion: SiPE验证了句法先验注入的有效位置和方式高度依赖架构：解码器（相对位置编码）偏好乘法耦合到注意力分数中的相对位置项，编码器偏好直接加入输入嵌入。该工作证明了以极低推理成本注入句法监督不仅能提升句法泛化，还能同时改善困惑度和通用语言理解能力，为句法感知的预训练语言模型开辟了新方向。

Abstract: Positional embeddings (PE) in Transformers encode token distance and order but are largely agnostic to \textit{syntactic structure}. We introduce \textbf{S}yntax-\textbf{i}nformed \textbf{P}ositional \textbf{E}mbeddings (\textbf{SiPE}), which learns a lightweight syntactic prior from dependency parses during pretraining and injects it across all three dominant PE families (absolute, relative, rotary), for both encoders and decoders, leaving self-attention and the rest of the architecture untouched. We isolate \emph{where} and \emph{how} the prior should enter the model, and find it depends on the architecture: for autoregressive decoders that use relative PE, the prior is strongest when coupled multiplicatively with the relative-position term of the attention score, outperforming injection into the input embeddings, into self-attention, or into the positional and attention terms jointly---while for encoders it is best added directly to the input embeddings, composing with each encoder's native positional mechanism. We find that models pre-trained with SiPE improve on the SyntaxGym benchmark by up to $10.3\%$ while simultaneously reducing perplexity by $9.0\%$ over a base model with no syntactic supervision---a metric nearly every existing syntax-injection method instead degrades. Crucially, these gains extend beyond syntactic generalization: SiPE also improves real-world language understanding, raising scores on the GLUE benchmark by up to $8.2\%$ over a model trained without it. Unlike existing syntactic language models that marginalize over many parses at inference or discard syntax at runtime, SiPE conditions on a single parse, establishing a new Pareto frontier between syntactic supervision and inference cost.

</details>


### [162] [Decolonizing Linguistic Policies in Automated Speech Recognition: A Framework for Cross-Culturally Competent Speech AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06141)
*Jay L. Cunningham,Mark Atta Mensah,Richard Martinez,Joao Vieira da Silva Neto,Efi Dawodu*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文批判性地审视自动语音识别（ASR）及其语音界面在公共服务、医疗和教育中的使用，指出其对低资源语言、原住民语言和非标准语言变体的持续性识别失败不仅是技术错误，更是隐性的语言政策，再生产了殖民语言等级体系。论文提出了"三重伤害（3M）"分类法和一个七层情境化模型，并倡导参与式框架与最低审计协议，将受影响社区定位为共同设计者、评估者和治理伙伴。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ASR系统在低资源、原住民及非标准语言变体上反复失败，这一问题常被当作纯技术缺陷处理，而作者认为其根源在于数据、指标和模型先验中嵌入的结构性偏见，构成隐性语言政策，延续殖民语言等级。现有研究缺乏系统性框架来理解这种社会—技术层面的伤害，也缺乏将受影响社区纳入治理的方案。

Method: 论文采用跨学科理论整合路径，综合语言资本、种族语言学意识形态、语言政策研究以及去殖民计算等理论视角，分析数据、指标和模型先验如何决定哪些声音可被机器识别。在此基础上提出两大分析工具：（1）3M分类法——Misrecognition（误认）、Misalignment（错位）、Mistrust（不信任）；（2）七层情境化模型，用于刻画ASR及其界面中的语言多样性问题。最后构建参与式框架和最小审计协议，赋予受影响社区共同设计者、评估者和治理合作伙伴的角色。

Result: 本文产出包括：一个用于诊断ASR伤害的三重分类体系（3M）；一个覆盖七层的语言多样性情境化模型；以及一套参与式设计框架和最低审计协议。这些工具为评估和改进ASR系统的文化胜任力提供了具体操作路径。

Conclusion: 作者主张ASR失败不仅是工程问题，而是需要从社会政治维度系统性回应的语言政策问题。实现文化胜任的ASR必须从根本上转变权力结构，让受影响社区从被动用户变为共同设计者、评估者和治理伙伴，以打破殖民语言等级体系的再生产。

Abstract: This paper focuses on automatic speech recognition (ASR) and ASR-mediated voice interfaces that shape access to public services, healthcare, and education. We argue that persistent failures for low-resource, Indigenous, and non-standard language varieties are not only technical errors, but also implicit linguistic policies that reproduce colonial language hierarchies. Drawing on linguistic capital, raciolinguistic ideology, language policy research, and decolonial computing, we show how data, metrics, and model priors determine whose voices become machine-legible. We introduce the Three Harms (3M) taxonomy---Misrecognition, Misalignment, and Mistrust---and a seven-layer situatedness model for linguistic diversity in ASR and ASR-mediated voice interfaces. We then propose a participatory framework and minimum audit protocol for culturally competent ASR, positioning affected communities as co-designers, evaluators, and governance partners.

</details>


### [163] [Routing Is Least Learnable Where It Is Most Valuable: Bounds on Representation Routing for Web Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06171)
*Jiaming Wei,Zekun Wu,Adriano Koshiyama,Maria Perez-Ortiz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文在VisualWebArena和WebArena上系统测量了六种观察模式（文本、像素或二者结合）在8个站点-模型组合上的表现，发现各模式具有互补性且彼此无法取代。虽然存在"预言机"式的理想路由看似收益巨大，但通过重跑实验发现其中12-14%的收益来自噪声。最终结论是：五种路由策略均无法稳定超越固定单一最优模式，根本原因在于路由监督信号受制于智能体自身成功率——智能体越弱，路由获得的标签越少，而这恰恰是最需要路由的场景。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Web智能体的观察模式（文本、像素或两者）通常为所有任务一次性固定选择，但不同任务可能受益于不同观察模式。本文旨在量化"按任务选择观察模式"这一路由策略可能带来的收益，并检验路由策略是否真的优于固定单一模式。

Method: 在VisualWebArena和WebArena上的8个站点-模型组合（cells）中测量6种观察模式的表现；通过重跑同一模式以估算运行噪声；设计并测试5种路由策略（固定选择、强模式支出决策、基于任务文本的零成本规则、置信度级联、池化成本分层）；计算路由监督信号与智能体成功率的关联。

Result: 六种模式互补且失败方式不同；预言机路由看似收益大但12-14%被噪声膨胀；仅发送无模式可解任务到最廉价模式可在8/8个cells上节约9.5-30.6%成本且成功率不变；5种路由策略均无法稳健超越固定单一模式；路由监督标签量随智能体成功率上升，二者相关系数达0.95。

Conclusion: 当前智能体能力下，路由策略难以超越固定模式选择，核心瓶颈在于弱智能体产生的监督标签不足。但该限制属于当前智能体而非路由方法本身——更强的智能体将同时获得更多路由标签和更大的路由机会，因此更强的基座模型有望使路由策略产生实质性收益。

Abstract: Web agents observe a browser through text, pixels, or both, and the choice is usually fixed once for all tasks. We measure six observation modes across eight site-model combinations (cells) on VisualWebArena and WebArena and ask what choosing per task would buy. The modes are complementary: each solves tasks the others miss, they fail in structurally different ways, and the best choice reverses between task sets. The obvious prize, an oracle that picks a winning mode for every task, looks large but is inflated by run-to-run noise: rerunning the same mode on the same tasks changes 12-14% of outcomes, so a second run of a mode already in hand gains about as much as adding a new one. What survives is a cost bound: sending only the tasks no mode solves to the cheapest mode cuts cost by 9.5-30.6% in 8 of 8 cells at unchanged success. We then test five routing policies (picking the mode, deciding when to spend on the strong mode, a zero-cost rule read off the task text, a confidence cascade, and pooled cost tiers), and none robustly beats simply fixing one well-chosen mode; the one exception is a fragile result in our sparsest cell. The central obstruction is that routing supervision is produced at the agent's success rate: the weaker the agent, the fewer labels a router gets, exactly where routing would be most valuable. This limit belongs to today's agents rather than to routing itself. Label supply and routing opportunity rise together (correlation 0.95 across cells), so a stronger agent can overturn the result, and we report the rerun noise bands and the full measurement protocol.

</details>


### [164] [NeSy-RAG: Neuro-Symbolic RAG for Explainable Question Answering](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06292)
*Jonas Gann,Michael Gertz*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出NeSy-RAG，一个模块化的神经符号检索增强生成框架，通过将检索文本合成为可溯源的Prolog模块，实现可验证、可归因的推理，并引入符号知识缺口检测机制自动识别缺失的用户上下文。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有RAG系统虽能通过外部知识提升LLM的问答能力，但推理过程不透明，中间步骤难以验证且无法可靠归因到具体证据；同时用户特定的上下文缺失难以被系统化检测，常导致不完整或错误的输出。

Method: NeSy-RAG方法包括：(1) 从每个检索文本块合成可溯源的Prolog模块，生成语义谓词编码布尔声明；(2) 利用联合自然语言-代码嵌入检索谓词并组合成Prolog查询；(3) 引入符号知识缺口检测机制，识别影响查询结果但缺失的用户事实，并自动触发后续交互；(4) 执行Prolog查询产生确定性答案及透明的执行轨迹。

Result: 在ShARC基准测试上，无需领域特定训练，NeSy-RAG达到61.1%的准确率，显著优于同模型RAG基线的42.8%。

Conclusion: NeSy-RAG通过神经符号融合实现了可解释、可归因的RAG推理，并能够系统化处理用户上下文缺失问题，显著提升了问答准确率。

Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) improves question answering by grounding large language models (LLMs) in external knowledge such as text corpora. However, its reasoning process remains largely opaque: intermediate reasoning steps are difficult to verify and cannot be reliably attributed to specific evidence. Moreover, missing user-specific context is rarely detected systematically, often leading to incomplete or incorrect output.
  We propose NeSy-RAG, a modular neuro-symbolic RAG framework that synthesizes attributable Prolog modules from retrieved text chunks. For each chunk, the system generates semantically meaningful predicates that encode Boolean claims, which may depend on user facts. Using joint natural language-code embeddings, predicates are retrieved and composed into Prolog queries. To address incomplete user context, we introduce a symbolic knowledge-gap detection mechanism that identifies missing user facts whose truth values affect the query outcome and automatically triggers follow-up interactions.
  Executing the resulting Prolog queries yields deterministic answers together with transparent execution traces that link each reasoning step to its originating source. On the ShARC benchmark, without domain-specific training, NeSy-RAG achieves 61.1% accuracy, outperforming a same-model RAG baseline that achieves 42.8% accuracy.

</details>


### [165] [Benchmarking and Enhancing LLMs for Rule-Intensive Review of National Standard Documents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06312)
*Tao Wang,Qihao Yang,Rongjiao Liang,Lianghong Lin,Haitao Wang,Xinyu Cao,Tianyong Hao*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出了GB/T-Bench，这是首个针对国家标准文档结构化审查的基准，包含层次化审查分类体系（25种可诊断错误类型）和可控反例生成机制，并提出了多智能体框架GB/T-Reviewer用于规则密集型文档审查。实验表明最强LLM仅达到0.3280 CMCS（专家为0.6640），GB/T-Reviewer将其提升至0.5094。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大型语言模型在规则密集型文档审查中的能力尚未得到充分评估。现有基准主要关注领域知识和问答，忽略了专业文档的内在质量审查。国家标准文档（如GB/T标准）具有篇幅长、结构高度规范化、受明确规则约束的特点，是理想测试平台，但此类审查依赖人类专家，成本高且难以规模化。

Method: 1) 构建GB/T Review Taxonomy层次化分类体系，覆盖文档结构、范围一致性、规范性表述、术语一致性和规范性引用五个维度，包含25种可诊断错误类型；2) 设计可控反例生成机制，结合确定性规则与受约束的LLM重写，将488份文档处理为7,306个可追溯的审查错误实例；3) 提出面向诊断的评估协议，要求错误位置、审查维度和错误类型的精确匹配，并包含文档级覆盖率指标；4) 提出GB/T-Reviewer多智能体框架，将审查知识转化为专门技能，协调全局检查、定向诊断、规则扫描和结果验证四个环节。

Result: 在14个主流LLM上实验显示巨大的人机差距：最强模型仅达0.3280 CMCS，专家达0.6640；GB/T-Reviewer将最佳CMCS提升至0.5094，验证了结构化技能协调对规则密集型文档审查的价值。

Conclusion: 该工作为标准化及其他高风险文档领域中的可信AI铺平了道路，证明了结构化技能协调框架在提升LLM规则密集型文档审查能力方面的有效性。

Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) increasingly support complex professional tasks, yet their capabilities in rule-intensive document review remain insufficiently evaluated. National standard documents, such as China GB/T standards, offer a representative testbed: they are lengthy, highly structured, and governed by explicit rules for scope, terminology, normative wording, and cross-section consistency. Existing benchmarks focus on domain knowledge and question answering, largely overlooking intrinsic quality review for professional documents. Such reviews rely heavily on human experts, making them costly and difficult to scale. To bridge this gap, we introduce GB/T-Bench, the first benchmark for the structured review of national standard documents. Its GB/T Review Taxonomy is a hierarchical schema covering document structure, scope alignment, normative modality, terminology consistency, and normative references, with 25 diagnosable error types. A controllable counterexample generation mechanism combines deterministic rules and constrained LLM rewriting to process 488 documents into 7,306 traceable review error instances for evaluation. We also develop a diagnosis-oriented evaluation protocol requiring exact matches on error location, review dimension, and error type, plus document-level coverage metrics. We further propose GB/T-Reviewer, a multi-agent framework that converts review knowledge into specialized skills and coordinates global inspection, targeted diagnosis, rule scanning, and result verification. Experiments with 14 mainstream LLMs reveal a substantial human-LLM gap: the strongest model achieves only 0.3280 CMCS versus 0.6640 for experts. GB/T-Reviewer raises the best CMCS to 0.5094, showing the value of structured skill coordination for rule-intensive document review. This work paves the way for trustworthy AI in standardization and other high-stakes document domains.

</details>


### [166] [Benchmarking the Benchmarks: Evaluating Benchmarks for Conversational Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06329)
*Noam Koren,Roy Bar-Haim,Abigail Goldsteen*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无参考框架，利用LLM作为裁判来评估任务导向对话代理基准的质量，涵盖一致性、复杂性和策略覆盖度三个维度，并提供可操作的诊断信息。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 任务导向对话代理的性能评估依赖基准，但基准本身的质量很少被评估。低质量基准可能包含不一致的任务、过于简单的场景或有限的策略覆盖，导致评估结果不可靠。

Method: 提出一个无参考框架，使用LLM裁判来评估基准的一致性（consistency）、复杂性（complexity）和策略覆盖度（policy coverage），并提供可操作的弱点诊断。通过独立人工标注的一致性验证框架有效性，并测试不同能力的LLM生成的基准以及经过可控质量退化扰动处理的基准。

Result: 跨多个领域和裁判模型，所提出的指标能够一致地区分不同质量的基准级别；框架同样适用于人工整理的基准。

Conclusion: 该框架为评估合成和人工整理的对话代理基准提供了一种实用的方法。

Abstract: Task-oriented conversational agents are evaluated using curated or automatically generated benchmarks, yet benchmark quality is rarely assessed. Poor benchmarks may contain inconsistent tasks, simplistic scenarios, or limited policy coverage, leading to unreliable evaluations. We introduce a reference-free framework that uses LLM judges to assess benchmark consistency, complexity, and policy coverage, while providing actionable diagnostics of weaknesses. We validate the framework by demonstrating agreement with independent human annotations and by evaluating benchmarks generated by LLMs of varying capabilities, as well as benchmarks subjected to controlled quality-degrading perturbations. Across domains and judge models, the proposed metrics consistently distinguish between benchmark quality levels. We further demonstrate the framework's applicability to manually curated benchmarks. Our framework offers a practical approach for evaluating synthetic and manually curated conversational-agent benchmarks.

</details>


### [167] [RP-OPSD: Reasoning-Pivot-Guided On-Policy Self-Distillation for Multilingual Reasoning Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06347)
*Xinye Wang,Junxiao Liu,Shujian Huang*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出RP-OPSD（推理枢轴引导的在线策略自蒸馏）方法，通过识别目标语言推理中的"推理枢轴"（推进或改变推理过程的关键决策token），并利用有无英文参考答案时教师视图之间的分布偏移作为代理信号，对这些关键token进行特权蒸馏和参考锚定。在覆盖17种语言和多难度级别的数学推理基准上，该方法优于强多语言推理基线和现有OPSD变体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多语言推理转移对于将LLM的推理能力扩展到高资源语言之外至关重要。现有的在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）及其变体虽然能提供密集的token级监督，但其目标函数并未显式优先考虑对跨语言迁移最关键的推理信号。作者观察到目标语言推理既包含表层文本生成，也包含"推理枢轴"——即推进或改变推理过程、塑造后续推断的关键决策，因此需要将特权蒸馏集中在这些枢轴周围。

Method: RP-OPSD采用两阶段的代理机制：(1) 通过比较有无英文参考解时匹配教师视图之间的分布偏移，作为一个可操作的代理来识别推理枢轴；(2) 基于该代理信号引导特权蒸馏和参考锚定，从而实现对推理控制token和问题条件化状态更新token的重点蒸馏，同时降低对主要支撑表层实现的token的权重。

Result: 在覆盖17种语言和多个难度级别的数学推理基准上，RP-OPSD优于强多语言推理基线和OPSD变体。进一步分析表明，该方法将特权蒸馏集中在推理控制和问题条件化状态更新token上，同时对主要支撑表层实现的token进行了降权。

Conclusion: RP-OPSD证明了对推理枢轴进行针对性特权蒸馏能够显著提升跨语言推理迁移的效果，其通过教师视图分布偏移识别关键推理信号的方法为一个通用且有效的范式。代码已开源。

Abstract: Multilingual reasoning transfer is crucial for extending reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) beyond high-resource languages. On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) and its variants have emerged as a promising paradigm, providing dense token-level supervision on student-generated rollouts, yet their objectives do not explicitly prioritize reasoning signals most critical to cross-lingual transfer. We characterize that target-language reasoning comprises the generation of both surface text and reasoning pivots, which are decisions that advance or redirect the reasoning process and shape subsequent inference. This motivates concentrating privileged distillation around such pivots. We therefore propose RP-OPSD, Reasoning-Pivot-guided On-Policy Self-Distillation, using the distributional shift between matched teacher views with and without an English reference solution as an operational proxy to guide privileged distillation and reference anchoring. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks covering 17 languages and multiple difficulty levels show that our method outperforms strong multilingual reasoning baselines and OPSD variants. Further analysis reveals that RP-OPSD concentrates privileged distillation on reasoning-control and problem-condistioned state-update tokens, while downweighting it for tokens that mainly support surface realization. Our code is available at https://github.com/NJUNLP/RP-OPSD.

</details>


### [168] [The Bitter Lesson of Tool Calling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06370)
*Ishan Patel,Sahil Sen,Elias Lumer,Vamse Kumar Subbiah*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文系统地比较了程序化工具调用（PTC）与原生JSON工具调用在14个语言模型上的表现（基于BFCL v4基准）。结果显示PTC在11/14的模型上匹配或超越JSON工具调用，GPT-5.6系列提升10.6%，在并行扇出场景下13/14模型匹配或超越基线，且在上下文轮换条件下表现稳定。

tldr


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 此前缺乏对"工具即代码"范式在已建立基准上、跨当前及先前模型代际、真实任务条件下的系统性评估。程序化工具调用（以类型化Python桩暴露工具，通过代码调用并链式并行执行）有望替代刚性JSON调用，但缺少实证验证。

Method: 在BFCL v4基准上，对14个语言模型进行程序化工具调用（PTC）与原生JSON工具调用的对比实验。PTC将工具暴露为类型化Python存根，模型通过代码调用工具，执行与结果在同一智能体回合内处理。评估涵盖标准场景、并行扇出场景及上下文轮换（context rot）条件。

Result: PTC在14个模型中有11个匹配或超越JSON工具调用基线；GPT-5.6系列相对基线提升10.6%；并行扇出场景下13/14模型匹配或超越基线；在上下文轮换条件下基线平均下降2.3%而PTC保持稳定。

Conclusion: 程序化工具调用是JSON工具调用的可行且稳健的替代方案，其性能随模型发布代际的能力提升而同步演进，表明"工具即代码"范式具有可扩展性和鲁棒性。

Abstract: Tool use transforms LLMs into agents that act beyond their training data, and for code-capable models, programmatic tool calling extends this further by replacing rigid JSON calls with scripts that chain and parallelize naturally. However, a systematic evaluation of tools as code on an established benchmark across current and prior model generations under real-world task conditions has not been conducted. In this work, we empirically compare programmatic tool calling (PTC) to native JSON tool calling across 14 language models on BFCL v4. In the programmatic tool calling paradigm, tools are exposed as typed Python stubs that the model invokes through code, with execution and results handled in a single agent turn. Programmatic tool calling matches or exceeds native JSON tool calling in 11 of 14 models on BFCL v4, with the GPT-5.6 family achieving a 10.6% improvement over the JSON tool calling baseline. Further, it matches or outperforms baseline in 13 of 14 models under parallel fan-out, and holds stable under context rot conditions where baseline degrades 2.3% on average. Our results demonstrate that programmatic tool calling is a viable and robust alternative to JSON tool calling, with performance tracking model capability across release generations.

</details>


### [169] [Learning When to Trust via Selective Context Preference Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06377)
*Xian Sun,Wei Chow,Yingshuo Wang,Junhao Liu,Wei Gao,Qing Wu,Lingdong Kong*

Main category: cs.CL

TL;DR: 本文提出将语言模型对外部信号的响应问题重新定义为"选择性信任"问题，并引入MIST基准（人类标注，四种匹配条件下的推理任务）和SC2W配对指标（衡量误导信号将正确回答翻转的概率）。研究发现误导信号的脆弱性是普遍存在的。作者提出SCOPE方法，通过挖掘clean-correct/misleading-wrong失败样本，并在四种条件下平衡配对偏好对，使用DPO目标优化，显著降低SC2W同时保持正确上下文下的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型越来越多地依赖外部信号进行回答，但单一误导性信号足以将正确答案变为错误。传统上简单训练模型抵抗误导信号存在失败模式：完全忽略上下文的模型看似鲁棒，但在上下文值得信任时却毫无用处。因此需要将问题重新定义为选择性信任——模型既不能盲目信任上下文，也不能完全忽视上下文。

Method: 1) 构建MIST基准，将每个推理题目置于四种匹配条件下（干净、误导、正确上下文、无关上下文）；2) 提出SC2W配对指标，统计误导信号将干净条件中的正确答案翻转为错误答案的频率；3) 提出SCOPE方法，挖掘clean-correct/misleading-wrong失败模式，并在四种条件间平衡相等的配对偏好对，使用标准DPO目标优化，而非仅对误导样本进行优化。

Result: 在全面的基准研究中发现误导信号的脆弱性在多个流行开源模型上普遍存在。SCOPE方法在显著降低SC2W的同时，保持了模型在干净、正确或无关上下文条件下的准确率，即实现了选择性信任而非单纯抵抗。

Conclusion: 作者主张模型应当以选择性信任而非单纯抵抗能力为标准进行评估。模型的评判应基于其是否能区分可信与不可信的上下文信号，而不是一味抵抗所有外部信息或盲目信任所有上下文。

Abstract: Language models increasingly condition their answers on external signals, and a single misleading one can turn a correct answer wrong. The obvious remedy, training models to resist such signals, hides a failure mode: a model that ignores all context looks robust yet is useless when the context is worth trusting. We recast the problem as selective trust and introduce MIST, a human-annotated benchmark that renders each reasoning item under four matched conditions (clean, misleading, correct-context, and irrelevant-context), together with SC2W, a paired metric counting how often a misleading signal flips a clean-correct answer to wrong. Across a comprehensive benchmark study, we observe that such a susceptibility is universal. We then propose SCOPE, which mines clean-correct/misleading-wrong failures and optimizes a standard Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) objective over matched preference pairs balanced equally across all four conditions, rather than over misleading items alone. Our approach substantially reduces SC2W on popular open-sourced models while preserving accuracy when the added context is clean, correct, or irrelevant. With this work, we argue that models should be judged on selective trust, not on resistance alone.

</details>


<div id='q-bio.NC'></div>

# q-bio.NC [[Back]](#toc)

### [170] [The ethics of artificial intelligence in the life sciences: Universality, cultural diversity and an architecture of care](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05436)
*Jean-Pierre Changeux,Gustavo Deco,Morten L. Kringelbach*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文认为人工智能引发的伦理问题并非独特，而应基于人类大脑的计算架构与奖赏机制来理解。作者提出，应以"全局神经工作空间"和"想要-喜欢-满足"的连续奖赏循环为原则构建机器，将治理问题从"约束"转向"教养"。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生命科学与健康研究正受益于人工智能，但引发了一系列伦理担忧。作者认为这些担忧虽然真实，却并非人工智能所独有，应回归人类大脑本身的构造与社会化过程来理解伦理问题。

Method: 作者采用概念分析与跨学科论证：（1）指出人类大脑与AI计算架构的根本差异（全局神经工作空间、低能耗）；（2）重新定义奖赏为"想要-喜欢-满足"的连续循环而非需最大化的数量；（3）区分伦理判断的普遍性与道德内容的多样性；（4）提出基于这些原则构建机器的替代路径及相应的治理制度设想。

Result: 文章论证了：人类大脑的全局工作空间与情感网络具有普遍性，但其内容因表观遗传与环境交互而个性化；如果按照这些原则而非现有的"奖赏最大化"方式构建机器，AI治理问题将从中性约束转变为类似人的教养过程，并提出了相应制度框架及悬而未决的问题。

Conclusion: 人工智能伦理不应被特殊化，而应根植于对人类大脑运作机制的深入理解。未来AI治理的关键在于以"教养"替代"约束"，这需要重新设计机器的计算架构与奖赏机制，并建立相应的制度保障。

Abstract: The life sciences and health research have started to benefit from artificial intelligence, which raises ethical concerns that are real but, we argue, not special. Any science should be governed by values that rest on how the human brain is built and socialised rather than anything distinct to artificial intelligence. Importantly, the human brain has a different, much less costly computational architecture than these machines. This is achieved through the orchestration of a global neuronal workspace, and through reward best described not as a quantity to be maximised but as a continuous cycle of wanting, liking and satiety. As such, this creates the deep tension running through the ethics of the human person, between the universality of ethical judgement and the diversity of morals. The brain networks of the global workspace and emotion are universally shared, but the diversity of content is shaped by epigenetic appropriation of the particulars of the physical, social and cultural world, which makes every person unique. Still, if we were to build machines on these principles rather than the present unaffordable reward maximisers, the question of their governance would change from restraint to upbringing. We set out the institutions such a future would require, together with the questions that remain open.

</details>


### [171] [Effective pruning of task-trained recurrent neural networks using noisy fluctuations and connection rescaling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05464)
*Sanjith Senthil,Rishidev Chaudhuri*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文验证了noise-prune这一生物合理的无监督局部剪枝规则在任务训练的循环神经网络中能够保持任务性能，优于仅基于连接强度的策略，与使用二阶信息的非局部策略相当或更优，并发现其采样的连接保留和强度重缩放机制对性能至关重要，且最优重缩放程度低于原始理论预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 网络连接剪枝对大脑功能至关重要，但现有生物合理的剪枝规则很少且缺乏在功能性网络上的性能验证。noise-prune此前仅在无特定计算功能的随机网络上测试过，其是否能在功能性循环网络中保持任务性能尚未得到验证。

Method: 在任务训练的循环神经网络上评估noise-prune剪枝规则，将其与基于连接幅值的策略和基于二阶信息的非局部策略进行比较；同时系统研究其"基于重要性采样保留连接"和"重缩放保留连接以维持平均突触强度"两个关键机制，并扫描重缩放的强度参数。

Result: noise-prune在任务训练的循环神经网络中保持了任务性能，大幅优于仅使用连接幅值的策略，与使用二阶信息的非局部策略表现相当或更优。采样和重缩放机制对性能至关重要，但最优经验重缩放程度低于原始理论论证所预测的值。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了noise-prune作为功能性循环网络架构中一种生物合理的剪枝规则的有效性，并刻画了其最优参数设置，为生物启发的神经网络剪枝提供了有力支撑。

Abstract: The pruning of network connections is key to brain function but, despite its importance, there exist few biologically-plausible pruning rules with demonstrated good performance. In this work we evaluate noise-prune, a recently introduced unsupervised local pruning rule for recurrent networks that uses noisy fluctuations to determine the importance of connections. Noise-prune has previously only been empirically tested on random networks without a specific computational function. We show that noise-prune preserves task-performance in task-trained recurrent neural networks, greatly outperforming a strategy that only uses the magnitude of connections and performing on par with or exceeding a non-local strategy that uses second-order information. Rather than deterministically removing connections that fall below a certain threshold importance, noise-prune samples connections to preserve based on their importance and strengthens retained connections to preserve average synaptic strength. We show that this sampling and rescaling is essential to good performance, but that the optimal empirical degree of rescaling is lower than that predicted by the original theoretical argument. Our work thus validates noise-prune as a biologically-plausible pruning rule for functional recurrent network architectures and characterizes its optimal parameter settings.

</details>


### [172] [From Local Learning to Global Prediction Through Layered Surprise Cascades](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05481)
*Andrew L. Smith,Linxing Preston Jiang,Jason K. Eshraghian,Matthew S. Bull,Stefano Recanatesi*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出一个生物合理的预测编码框架，通过局部对比学习和简单的活动抵消机制（基于前向-前向算法的循环变体），使预测编码的功能目标自然涌现，无需依赖生物合理性存疑的错误编码神经元或生成模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层级预测编码是大脑计算的重要假说，但现有模型多依赖错误编码神经元或生物合理性不明确的生成建模。作者希望找到一个更符合生物机制的框架，使预测编码的核心理念从简单的局部学习规则中自然涌现。

Method: 基于机器学习的最新进展，提出前向-前向（Forward-Forward, FF）算法的循环变体，采用反转目标（inverted objective）来增加负样本数据的活动。通过这个设置，跨层构建预测性表征，捕捉皮层计算的特征，包括自上而下的调制和惊讶信号。

Result: 该框架成功产生了预测性表征，并复现了皮层计算的关键特征（如自上而下调制和惊讶信号），表明预测编码的核心原理可以从简单的局部学习规则中涌现。

Conclusion: 该工作为神经科学与机器学习的交叉提供了新桥梁，证明简单的局部对比学习规则可以产生预测编码的核心功能，为理解大脑计算提供了更具生物合理性的理论框架。

Abstract: Hierarchical predictive coding proposes a compelling hypothesis of brain computation, suggesting that the cortex builds layered predictions to minimize surprise. Yet most models rely on error-coding neurons or generative modeling of unclear biological plausibility. Here, we examine a biologically plausible framework in which the functional goals of predictive coding emerge from local contrastive learning and simple activity cancellation. Building on recent machine learning advances, we present a recurrent variant of the Forward-Forward (FF) algorithm with an inverted objective that increases activity for negative data. This setup yields predictive representations across layers, capturing hallmark features of cortical computation such as top-down modulation and surprise signaling. Our results suggest that key principles of predictive coding can emerge from simple, local learning rules, offering a new bridge between neuroscience and machine learning.

</details>


### [173] [Transcutaneous Spinal Cord Stimulation Disrupts Conscious Ankle Proprioception and Produces a More Constrained Locomotor Pattern in Unimpaired Adults](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05635)
*Christopher A. Johnson,Andria J. Farrens,Parastoo Ali Pour,Arjan Gillan,Hui Zhong,David J. Reinkensmeyer,Alexandra S. Voloshina*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本研究探讨经皮脊髓电刺激(tSCS)对踝关节本体感觉和步态的影响。结果显示，急性tSCS增加踝关节本体感觉误差（p<0.001）但力量不变，同时步态趋于更受限的运动模式。在持续训练下，tSCS组的本体感觉误差逐渐下降并产生持久改善，而步态在矢状面恢复/超越基线，侧向（内外侧）指标仍保持受限，揭示了一种方向依赖性的运动控制重组。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以往tSCS研究主要关注运动表现和脊髓兴奋性，但tSCS如何影响意识性本体感觉感知，以及这些效应与步态控制变化之间的平行关系尚不清楚。本研究旨在填补这一空白。

Method: 招募14名无损伤成人受试者接受tSCS干预，另设14人独立对照组仅接受相同的本体感觉训练但不接受电刺激。采用双侧机器人评估动态踝关节定位能力(Crisscross)量化本体感觉，测量最大背屈力量评估粗大运动输出，并在正常及串联跑步机行走条件下采集时空参数、躯干摆动和内外侧质心(CoM)摆动等步态指标，分别评估急性效应与训练相关效应。

Result: 急性tSCS使踝关节本体感觉误差显著增加(p<0.001)，但背屈力量无变化(p=0.30)。步态转向适度受限模式，表现为步宽和ML CoM摆动减少(p<0.05)。持续刺激训练后本体感觉误差降低，且tSCS组表现出进行性改善并在刺激停止后仍保持；矢状面步态指标恢复至或超过基线，而内外侧指标持续受限。

Conclusion: tSCS作用于感觉运动控制回路的多个层面：一方面干扰意识性本体感觉，另一方面重塑步态行为；神经系统可通过训练适应改变后的传入输入。这种方向依赖性的运动控制重组提示tSCS的神经调节效应具有选择性而非全局性。

Abstract: Transcutaneous spinal cord stimulation (tSCS) modulates spinal sensorimotor circuits primarily through activation of afferent networks. While prior work has emphasized locomotor performance and spinal excitability, how tSCS affects conscious proprioceptive perception and the extent to which such effects parallel changes in locomotor control remain unclear. We investigated the acute and training-related effects of tSCS on ankle proprioception and gait in unimpaired adults (n = 14), with an independent control group (n = 14) completing identical proprioceptive training without stimulation. Proprioception was quantified using a bilateral robotic assessment of dynamic ankle localization ability (Crisscross), gross motor output using maximum dorsiflexion strength, and gait during normal and tandem treadmill walking using spatiotemporal, trunk-sway, and mediolateral center-of-mass (CoM) excursion measures. Acute tSCS increased ankle proprioceptive error (p < 0.001) while dorsiflexion strength was unchanged (p = 0.30). Gait shifted toward a modestly more constrained locomotor pattern, characterized by reduced step width and ML CoM excursion (p < 0.05). With continued training under stimulation, proprioceptive error decreased and, unlike the control group, the tSCS group showed progressive improvement that persisted after stimulation ended. Sagittal-plane gait measures recovered toward or beyond baseline, whereas mediolateral measures remained constrained, revealing a direction-dependent reorganization of locomotor control. Together, these findings show that tSCS influences multiple aspects of the sensorimotor control loop, disrupting conscious proprioception while reshaping locomotor behavior, and that the nervous system can adapt to altered afferent input through training.

</details>


### [174] [Complexity and Stability of Neural Activity Across Aging and Neurodegenerative Disease](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05882)
*Junjie Yu,Jianyu Zhang,Zian Pei,Xue Shi,Yumei Liu,Xin Jiang,Quanying Liu,Yi Guo*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出一个基于分布层次的框架，使用Wasserstein距离和内在维度来量化EEG神经表征的时间稳定性与复杂性，发现神经表征在固定认知状态下呈现受限的条件特异性稳定而非无约束漂移；高内在维度与低稳定性相关，且两者具有可重复的空间组织；健康衰老表现为维度升高、稳定性降低，而轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病表现为两者联合塌缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG信号即使在固定的认知状态下也会持续波动，但大脑是否仍会随时间复用相似的活动模式来表征信息这一问题尚未明确。作者希望通过建模EEG活动模式的分布特性，系统性地回答神经表征的时间稳定性问题。

Method: 将EEG建模为滑窗活动模式的分布，使用Wasserstein距离量化分布的时域稳定性，利用内在维度（intrinsic dimensionality）捕获表征的复杂性。该方法在多种任务、生命周期和临床EEG数据集上进行了验证。

Result: 神经表征呈现受限的条件特异性稳定而非无约束漂移；较高的内在维度与较低稳定性一致相关，表明更丰富的表征空间在时间上的可复现性更低；两种度量均表现出可重复的空间组织，后部区域维度更高、稳定性更低；健康衰老表现为维度升高且稳定性降低，而轻度认知障碍和阿尔茨海默病则表现为两者的联合塌缩。

Conclusion: 该研究提供了一个分布层面的框架来理解认知、衰老和疾病中的神经稳定性，并可作为一种敏感的生物标志物，用于临床中追踪认知老化和神经退行性病变。

Abstract: Objective: EEG signals fluctuate continuously even within a fixed cognitive state, but an important question is whether the brain still reuses similar activity patterns to represent information over time. Methods: To address this, we model EEG as distributions of windowed activity patterns and quantify their temporal stability using Wasserstein distance, while intrinsic dimensionality captures representational complexity. Results: Across multi-task, lifespan, and clinical EEG datasets, we find that neural representations show constrained, condition-specific stability rather than unconstrained drift. Higher intrinsic dimensionality is consistently associated with lower stability, suggesting that richer representational spaces are less reproducible over time. Both measures exhibit reproducible spatial organization, with posterior regions showing higher dimensionality and lower stability than frontal regions. Healthy aging is characterized by increased dimensionality and reduced stability, whereas mild cognitive impairment and Alzheimer's disease show a joint collapse of both. Conclusions: These findings provide a distribution-level framework for understanding neural stability across cognition, aging, and disease. Significance: This framework offers a principled approach to quantifying neural representational stability, with potential utility as a sensitive biomarker for tracking cognitive aging and neurodegeneration in clinical settings.

</details>


### [175] [Convergent Evolution in Algorithmic Space](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05985)
*Patrick Krauss,Achim Schilling,Andreas Maier,Thomas Kinfe,Henri Stübner,Niklas Römmelt,Claus Metzner*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于匹配的框架，用于在结构权重空间中对多层感知机进行比较，发现同一任务上训练的不同随机初始化网络会收敛到相近的结构区域（吸引子），并揭示了训练早期"功能先于形态变化"的有趣现象。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在进化生物学中，不相关的生物体面对相似功能需求时会独立演化出相似结构。作者好奇神经网络训练中是否存在类似的收敛演化：不同随机初始化的网络在同一任务上训练后，其内部权重结构是否会产生相似性。由于隐藏神经元可任意置换而不改变函数表示，直接比较权重矩阵会产生误导，因此需要一种能解决置换不变性的结构比较方法。

Method: 提出一个匹配式框架：首先利用置换不变的特征对隐藏神经元进行粗略对齐，然后通过迭代匈牙利匹配进行精细对齐。对齐后，使用专门设计用于强调任务相关权重模式的结构距离度量来比较网络。

Result: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和KMNIST上训练的小型MLP集成上测试，发现同一任务上训练的网络彼此之间比与不同任务训练的网络更接近。训练最早阶段还发现：分类准确率快速上升，但匹配后的结构距离尚未展现强任务特异性分离，全局权重分布也没有明显变化，而单个权重条目已经开始协调漂移，表明早期学习通过细微、分布式的调整来显著影响功能，同时几乎不改动粗粒度的网络形态。

Conclusion: 任务特定的训练引导初始随机网络走向结构网络空间中不同的区域（吸引子），实现类似收敛演化的现象。早期"功能先于形态变化"的发现为理解神经网络训练的动力学提供了新视角，并将作为未来研究更丰富动态过程的起点。

Abstract: In evolutionary biology, unrelated organisms can independently evolve similar structures when exposed to similar functional demands. Here we ask whether an analogous form of convergent evolution occurs during neural network training: do networks with different random initializations develop similar internal weight structures when trained on the same task? This question is technically nontrivial because hidden neurons can be arbitrarily permuted without changing the represented function, making direct matrix comparisons misleading. We introduce a matching-based framework for comparing multilayer perceptrons in structural weight space. Hidden neurons are first coarsely aligned using permutation-invariant features and then refined by iterative Hungarian matching. After alignment, networks are compared with structural distance metrics designed to emphasize task-relevant weight patterns. Applying this approach to ensembles of small MLPs trained on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST, we find that networks trained on the same task remain closer to one another than to networks trained on different tasks. Thus, task-specific training appears to guide initially random networks toward distinct regions, or attractors, in structural network space. The earliest phase of training reveals an additional and unexpected phenomenon. Classification accuracy rises rapidly before the matched structural distances show strong task-specific separation, and before the global weight distribution visibly changes. Nevertheless, individual weight entries already begin to drift in a coordinated manner. This suggests that early learning may first operate through subtle, distributed adjustments that strongly affect function while leaving coarse network morphology almost unchanged. We treat this early morphogenesis as a first glimpse of a richer dynamical process that will be investigated in future work.

</details>


### [176] [Convergent Evolution in Neural Representation Space: Emergent Order in Deep Belief Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05996)
*Patrick Krauss,Achim Schilling,Andreas Maier,Thomas Kinfe,Claus Metzner*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 深度信念网络（DBNs）在没有类别标签的纯无监督训练过程中，其内部表示会随着网络深度加深而自发地、逐步地放大数据中隐含的类别结构。实验表明，随着层数增加，类特异性聚类增强、表示变得更紧凑且原型化，但GDV与探针准确率揭示了类别结构的互补性方面。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究深度信念网络（DBNs）在无监督训练下学习的层次化生成模型，是否会在内部表示中自发组织出与未知数据类别相对应的结构，即纯无监督学习是否能够揭示并增强数据中的类别信息。

Method: 在MNIST、Fashion-MNIST和KMNIST数据集上训练DBNs，使用广义判别值（GDV）、训练后应用的监督探针、基于重建的抽象距离度量、有效维度和自由样本生成等多种分析方法，对逐层表示进行评估，并进行控制实验排除随机变换、权重边缘分布、降维和sigmoid饱和等替代解释。

Result: 类特异性聚类随深度增加而增强（跨数据集和网络宽度均一致）；该效应依赖于学习到的特征结构而非随机因素；第一隐藏层即使类身份对线性和非线性探针更易访问；深层表示更紧凑且原型化；GDV和探针准确率揭示了类别结构的不同互补方面——平均聚类的改善可以与少数困难类对的访问性降低共存。

Conclusion: 逐层生成式学习能够在无标签数据中自发发现并逐步放大类别相关结构，表明无监督的层次化特征学习本身具备组织数据类别信息的能力。

Abstract: Deep Belief Networks (DBNs) learn hierarchical generative models without class supervision. Here, we ask whether this purely unsupervised process nevertheless organizes internal representations according to the unknown data classes. We analyze successive layers of DBNs trained on MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, and KMNIST using the Generalized Discrimination Value (GDV), supervised probes applied only after training, a reconstruction-based measure of abstraction distance, effective dimensionality, and free sample generation. Remarkably, class-specific clustering generally increases with depth across datasets and network widths, although no label information is available during DBN training. Control experiments show that this effect depends on the learned feature structure and cannot be explained by random transformations, weight marginals, dimensionality reduction, or sigmoid saturation. The first hidden layers also frequently make class identity more accessible to linear and nonlinear probes. With greater depth, representations become increasingly compact and prototype-like as neurons acquire correlated feature directions. At the same time, GDV and probe accuracy reveal complementary aspects of class structure: improved average clustering can coexist with reduced accessibility for a few difficult class pairs. These findings demonstrate that layer-wise generative learning can spontaneously uncover and progressively amplify class-related structure in unlabeled data.

</details>


### [177] [Errorless Irrationality: A unified computational account of the inverse base-rate effect across predictive, observational, and unsupervised procedures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.06149)
*Lenard Dome,Andy J. Wills*

Main category: q-bio.NC

TL;DR: 本文通过两个实验逐步移除预测误差信号（从观察学习到无监督学习），发现逆基率效应仍然存在，表明该非理性偏差独立于监督学习流程。作者提出OSCAR模型，整合了既有最优模型的核心理算原理，并在无标签条件下通过模式完成机制产生自我生成反馈来驱动学习。OSCAR在大型监督数据集和两个新实验中表现优异，是首个能在三种学习程序中复现人类个体差异模式的模型，并能解释其他模型无法解释的眼动追踪数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 逆基率效应是类别竞争间歧义消解中的一个稳健偏差，但主流理论都将其归因于预测误差信号。作者希望检验该偏差是否依赖监督学习流程中的错误信号，并试图构建一个能统一解释观察学习、无监督学习与监督学习三种程序的统一理论模型。

Method: 设计了两个递进式实验：实验一从预测性学习转向观察性学习（移除反馈误差信号），实验二转向无监督学习（不再呈现类别标签）。在此基础上提出了OSCAR模型，该模型整合了最佳验证模型的核心计算原理，通过类似模式完成的自生成反馈机制来驱动学习动态。模型在大型已有监督数据集和两个新实验上进行了评估和对比。

Result: 逆基率效应在观察学习和无监督学习条件下均稳定存在，表明该偏差不依赖监督学习产生的预测误差。OSCAR模型在大型监督数据集和两个新实验中表现与替代模型相当或更优，是唯一能够在全部三种学习程序中复现人类个体差异模式的模型，并且成功解释了此前未被任何替代理论解释的眼动追踪数据。

Conclusion: 逆基率效应本质上独立于监督学习流程和外部预测误差信号，OSCAR模型通过自生成反馈机制（类似于模式完成）为观察和无监督条件下的响应偏差提供了统一的计算解释，且其跨程序泛化能力和对眼动数据的解释力远超现有替代模型。

Abstract: The inverse base-rate effect is a robust bias in how people resolve ambiguity between competing categories, and the most prominent theories explain it through prediction error. Across two experiments we progressively removed the elements of the predictive-learning design that supply such error signals: first by moving to observational learning, then to an unsupervised procedure in which category labels were not presented. The effect persisted--the irrational bias is independent of supervised learning procedures. We propose a new theory, OSCAR, that integrates core computational principles of the best-validated models and operates on self-generated feedback akin to pattern completion. OSCAR extends the learning dynamics underlying the response bias to observational and unsupervised procedures. Evaluated on a large preexisting supervised dataset in addition to the two new experiments reported here, OSCAR performs competitively against alternatives, and is the first model that reproduces the pattern of individual differences seen in humans across all three procedures. The model provides an explanation of hitherto unexplained eye-tracking data, something none of the alternative accounts provide.

</details>

### [178] [CLARA: Clarification of Language Ambiguity through Result Analysis for Natural-Language Cancer Genomics Queries](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05195)
*Pratyush Kumar Shukla,Manveer Singh Tib,Siddhant Garg*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: CLARA是一个用于癌症基因组学数据库自然语言查询的框架，它将问题表示为类型化的科学查询规范，考虑多种可能解释并执行，在估计结果分歧时要求用户澄清。在TCGA泛癌症图谱基准测试中，CLARA能以100%的召回率识别所有结果敏感的模糊性问题，同时无需澄清所有稳定的对比，在安全性和用户负担之间取得了显式的权衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自然语言界面可以简化癌症基因组学数据库的使用，但即使问题语言流畅，其科学含义仍可能存在歧义。不同的解读可能导致截然不同的科学结论，因此需要一种能够识别并处理这些模糊性的方法。

Method: CLARA框架将用户问题表示为类型化的科学查询规范，生成几种可能的解释并执行它们，当各解释的估计结果出现分歧时询问用户进行澄清。评估使用330个独特的可执行对比（涵盖变异范围、检测分母和样本情境三个维度）以及120个LLM生成并经人工审核的语言压力测试问题。

Result: 两个独立实现的执行引擎（SQLite与pandas）产生了完全一致的660个结果。在120个语言压力测试中，CLARA识别出全部60个结果敏感对比，且仅对13个稳定对比进行了不必要的澄清（准确率89.2%，召回率100%，特异度78.3%）。相比之下，独立的机器学习方法整体准确率更高（97.5%），但遗漏了一个关键对比。

Conclusion: 下游执行能够区分重要的和无关紧要的歧义，揭示了安全性与用户负担之间的显式权衡。CLARA证明了基于执行的歧义消解方法在精确性和安全性方面优于纯机器学习方法。

Abstract: A natural language interface can be used to make cancer genomics databases easier to use, but even if a question is perfectly fluent, its scientific meaning can be ambiguous. We propose CLARA, a framework that represents a question as a typed scientific query specification, considers a few possible interpretations, executes them, and asks for clarification when the estimates diverge. CLARA was assessed on mutation-prevalence contrasts among eight TCGA PanCancer Atlas cohorts and a 30-gene panel. This benchmark consisted of 330 unique executable contrasts varying in mutation scope, assay denominator, and sample context; 115 contrasts were result-sensitive and 215 were result-stable, per the preregistered definition of relative divergence greater than 0.10 or absolute divergence greater than 5 percentage points. An independently implemented pandas execution engine perfectly replicated all 660 results from the SQLite engine. In a separate 120-question LLM-generated, manually vetted language stress test, CLARA recognized all 60 result-sensitive contrasts and needlessly clarified 13 of 60 stable contrasts (accuracy 89.2%, sensitivity/recall 100%, specificity 78.3%). Standalone machine learning had superior overall accuracy (97.5%) but missed one critical contrast. This demonstrates that downstream execution can distinguish consequential from inconsequential ambiguity and reveal an explicit trade-off between safety and burden.

</details>


### [179] [Frozen but Not Always Accessible: A Representation Analysis of Genomic Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05329)
*Nirjhor Datta,Swakkhar Shatabda,M. Sohel Rahman*

Main category: q-bio.GN

TL;DR: 本文对多种冷冻基因组基础模型（DNABERT-2、Nucleotide Transformer、HyenaDNA、GENERATOR-v2、Omni-DNA）进行了表征可访问性分析，评估其在调控、表观遗传、启动子、剪接位点和变异效应预测等下游任务中的表现。研究发现冷冻探针在启动子任务上可恢复95-100%的微调性能，而剪接位点恢复率降至60-88%，表明局部生物学信号虽部分存在于冷冻表征中，但并非总能通过最终池化嵌入被访问。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基因组基础模型越来越多地被作为冷冻特征提取器用于下游序列预测，相比全量微调更高效，但目前尚不清楚这些模型编码的生物学信息在无需任务特定适配的情况下是否可被直接访问，因此需要系统性地分析冷冻表征的可访问性。

Method: 在统一冷冻探测协议下评估五个基因组语言模型，涵盖调控、表观遗传、启动子、剪接位点和变异效应预测任务；将诊断性读出分析与验证集选择的检查分开；采用分层探测、计算机模拟诱变、变异效应预测和嵌入几何分析等多种手段。

Result: 冷冻探针在启动子任务上可恢复95-100%的微调性能，但剪接位点任务平均恢复率仅60-88%；在基因组基准的编码区和物种判别分类上具有竞争力，但在部分调控和开放染色质区域（OCR）任务上差距较大。层析分析和变异效应预测表明局部生物学信号存在但并非总能通过最终池化嵌入获得。

Conclusion: 冷冻基因组表征的可访问性具有明显的任务依赖性：局部生物学信号部分编码在冷冻表征中，但最终池化嵌入可能限制其可访问性，这为冷冻特征提取器在特定下游任务中的适用性提供了指导。

Abstract: Genomic foundation models are increasingly reused as frozen feature extractors for downstream sequence prediction, offering a compute-efficient alternative to full fine-tuning. However, it remains unclear when biological information encoded by these models is accessible without task-specific adaptation. We present a representation-accessibility analysis of frozen genomic language models across regulatory, epigenetic, promoter, splice-site, and variant-effect prediction tasks. We evaluate DNABERT-2, Nucleotide Transformer, HyenaDNA, GENERATOR-v2, and Omni-DNA under unified frozen-probing protocols, while separating diagnostic readout analyses from validation-selected checks. Our results reveal a consistent task-dependent pattern: frozen probes recover 95-100 % of fine-tuned performance on promoter tasks, but average splice-site recovery drops to 60-88 %. Frozen embeddings are also competitive on broad Genomic Benchmark tasks such as coding-region and species-discrimination classification, but show larger gaps on some regulatory and OCR tasks. Layer-wise probing, in-silico mutagenesis, variant-effect prediction, and embedding geometry show that local biological signal is partially present in frozen representations, but is not always accessible through final pooled embeddings.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [180] [VLAff: Vision-Language-Affordance Model for Unified Actionable Affordances](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05215)
*Jihoon Oh,Kento Kawaharazuka,Kei Okada*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出VLAff框架，从第一人称人类视频中提取物体中心的可操作affordance（包括视觉、抓取和轨迹），构建EgoAffordance大规模数据集（204K片段），并基于视觉语言模型训练统一基础模型，实现机器人零样本操控和affordance引导的机器人学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 从人类视频学习操控技能对可扩展机器人学习很有前景，但人类与机器人之间的形态不匹配（embodiment mismatch）是核心挑战。现有方法难以直接迁移人类演示到机器人操作。

Method: 1) 利用第一人称人类视频，结合最先进的3D Structure-from-Motion（SfM）和手部网格重建（hand mesh reconstruction）提取可操作affordance；2) 提取三种affordance：视觉affordance（在哪交互）、抓取affordance（如何抓取）、轨迹affordance（如何移动）；3) 构建EgoAffordance数据集（204K片断，5.6M视觉affordance，11.6M抓取和轨迹affordance）；4) 提出VLAff，一种基于大型视觉语言模型（VLM）的统一基础模型，学习所有可操作affordance之间的跨模态相关性；5) 给定视觉观察和指令，VLAff生成视觉affordance热图、抓取位姿和轨迹，并利用3D场景信息转化为可直接执行的动作。

Result: 在视觉affordance预测任务上达到最先进性能（SOTA）；可有效应用于真实机器人任务，包括零样本操控（zero-shot manipulation）和affordance引导的机器人学习。

Conclusion: 通过学习与形态无关（embodiment-agnostic）的物体中心可操作affordance，能够有效弥合人类与机器人之间的形态差距，实现从人类视频到真实机器人操控的可迁移学习。

Abstract: Learning manipulation skills from human videos is promising for scalable robot learning. However, the embodiment mismatch between humans and robots makes this challenging. One promising solution is to learn object-centric actionable affordances that are embodiment-agnostic. In this work, we propose a framework that leverages egocentric human videos with state-of-the-art 3D Structure-from-Motion and hand mesh reconstruction to extract actionable affordances such as visual, grasp, and trajectory affordances that explicitly encode where to interact, how to grasp, and how to move. We construct EgoAffordance, a large-scale dataset comprising 204K episodes with 5.6M visual affordances and 11.6M grasp and trajectory affordances. Building on this, we introduce VLAff, a large vision-language model-based unified foundation model that learns cross-modal correlations across all actionable affordances. Given a visual observation and instruction, VLAff generates visual affordance heatmaps, grasp poses, and trajectories, which are then converted into directly executable actions by utilizing 3D scene information. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that VLAff not only achieves state-of-the-art performance on visual affordance prediction, but can also be effectively applied to real robot applications such as zero-shot manipulation and affordance-guided robot learning.

</details>


### [181] [A System for Train Condition Monitoring and Structural Health Assessment of Rail Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05221)
*Maximilian Posner,Martin Dazer,Daniela Lauer,Robert Winkler-Höhn,Mathilde Laporte,Tobias Herrmann,Martin Köppel*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种将结构传感器技术与AI数据分析相结合的实时车辆状态监测和撞击检测方法，旨在解决干线铁路在GoA4全自动运行中的感知局限，实现撞击检测、状态修维护和长期数据分析三大应用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 尽管GoA4全自动运行在地铁系统中已成熟，但在干线铁路中的应用仍受限，主要因为严格的安全要求和开放运营环境的复杂性。现有基于摄像头、雷达和激光雷达的感知系统虽能检测物体，但在可靠识别撞击、碰撞和碾压事件方面能力有限。

Method: 提出一种新型实时车辆状态监测与撞击检测框架，将结构传感器技术与基于AI的数据分析相结合，涵盖三个关键应用场景：(1)自动化检测撞击、结构损伤和碾压事件；(2)通过连续监测实现基于状态的维护；(3)利用长期数据分析支持车辆设计优化。

Result: 研究结果证明了所提出方法的可行性，并展示了其在提升运营安全、实现预测性维护策略以及支持干线铁路系统向全自动运行过渡方面的潜力。

Conclusion: 该方案成功弥补了传统感知系统在撞击识别方面的不足，为干线铁路实现GoA4全自动运行提供了关键技术支撑，同时通过状态监测和长期数据分析双重赋能运维与设计优化。

Abstract: The ongoing digitalization of rail systems and the increasing use of artificial intelligence (AI) are fundamentally transforming the design, operation, and maintenance of rail vehicles. While fully automated operation at Grade of Automation 4 (GoA4) is well established in metro systems, its deployment in mainline rail remains limited. This is primarily due to stringent safety requirements and the complexity of open operational environments. Current perception systems based on cameras, radar, and lidar are effective in detecting objects but provide limited capability for reliably identifying impacts, collisions, and driving-over events. This paper presents a novel approach for real-time vehicle condition monitoring and impact detection that integrates structural sensor technologies with AI-based data analysis. The proposed framework addresses three key applications: (1) automated detection of impacts, structural damage, and driving-over events, (2) condition-based maintenance enabled by continuous monitoring, and (3) long-term data analytics to support vehicle design optimization. The results demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed approach and highlight its potential to enhance operational safety, enable predictive maintenance strategies, and support the transition toward fully automated operation in mainline rail systems

</details>


### [182] [Failing Gracefully: Mitigating Impact of Inevitable Robot Failures](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05313)
*Duc M. Nguyen,Saad A. Ghani,Andrew Marshall,Allison Andreyev,Gregory J. Stein,Xuesu Xiao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种新颖的安全公式，用于评估服务机器人在家庭环境中发生故障时与周围实体交互的概率和后果严重性，并提出了FailBench仿真框架来系统评估不同故障模式下的机器人-环境交互。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 服务机器人在家庭环境中与人类、宠物和日常物体共享空间，极易发生软件崩溃、硬件退化或不可预测交互等故障。虽然尽量减少故障很重要，但某些故障不可避免，因此需要缓解故障后果以确保安全可靠的部署。现有工作缺乏对故障影响的系统性评估方法。

Method: 提出一种新的安全公式，同时评估故障期间机器人与周围实体之间高影响力交互的概率及其后果的严重程度。通过量化故障对不同实体的影响，使机器人能够做出平衡安全性和任务效率的知情规划决策。同时提出FailBench，一个基于MuJoCo的仿真框架，用于研究不同故障模式（包括传感问题和执行器故障）下的机器人-环境交互。

Result: 安全公式和FailBench框架共同为在真实家庭环境中开发更安全、更稳健的运动规划和学习策略奠定了基础。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了安全评估公式与仿真测试平台，促进服务机器人故障场景下的安全运动规划与学习策略研究，为真实家庭环境中的可靠部署提供支撑。

Abstract: Service robots operate in household environments shared with humans, pets, and everyday objects, where they are highly susceptible to failures such as software crashes, hardware degradation, or unpredictable interactions. While roboticists strive to minimize failures, some remain inevitable, making it critical to mitigate their potential consequences for safe and reliable deployment. This paper introduces a novel safety formulation that evaluates both the probability of impactful interactions between robots and surrounding entities during failures, and the severity of their outcomes. By quantifying the impact of failures on different entities, our approach enables robots to make informed planning decisions that balance safety with task efficiency. To support systematic evaluation, we also present FailBench, a MuJoCo-based simulation framework for studying robot-environment interactions under diverse failure modes, including sensing issues and actuator malfunctions. Together, our safety formulation and FailBench provide a foundation for developing safer and more robust motion plans and learned policies in real-world household environments.

</details>


### [183] [Unified Planning-Learning Framework for Robust UUV Navigation Under Partial Observability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05365)
*Md Ether Deowan,Eleni Kelasidi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一个面向水下无人潜航器（UUV）的纯观测驱动自主导航框架，结合持续占用地图构建、全局清除约束路径规划、基于强化学习的局部控制以及行为树蒸馏技术，在部分可观测动态水下环境中实现了鲁棒且安全的导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 水下环境的动态性、部分可观测性以及对安全性的高要求，使得传统单一规划或学习方法难以胜任。现有方法未能充分整合全局结构信息与局部反应式决策，且在不确定性建模和训练稳定性方面存在不足，需要一种统一的混合规划-学习架构。

Method: 1) 仅利用机载声纳和深度图像构建持续占用地图；2) 采用清除约束全局规划器提供长时域结构；3) 引入强化学习策略处理短距离跟踪与反应式避障；4) 从传感器数据学习紧凑潜在状态表征以编码环境结构、障碍物动态与不确定性；5) 提出带分阶段监督的行为树蒸馏方法提升安全性与训练稳定性；6) 设计不确定性校准蒸馏机制，利用在线潜在模型不确定性对教师指导进行加权，强调高不确定区域的训练。

Result: 在基于NVIDIA Isaac Sim的高保真GPU加速仿真中，建立了可复现的多种子评估协议，并与行为树单独使用及标准RL基线进行对比，结果表明所提框架在动态条件下的鲁棒性和安全性均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个统一的混合规划-学习架构与可复现的评估方法论，为部分可观测条件下UUV鲁棒自主导航提供了通用解决方案。

Abstract: This paper presents an observation-only autonomy framework for Unmanned Underwater Vehicles (UUVs) navigation in dynamic underwater environments that integrates persistent occupancy mapping, global clearance-aware planning, and risk-aware local control. The proposed pipeline constructs occupancy maps solely from onboard sonar and depth image observations, adapts a clearance-constrained global planner (GP) to provide long-horizon structure, and integrates a reinforcement learning (RL) policy to handle short-range tracking and reactive avoidance. To further support decision-making under partial observability, the system learns a compact latent state representation from onboard sensor data, encoding environmental structure, obstacle dynamics, and uncertainty. Behavior tree (BT) distillation with staged supervision is introduced to improve safety and training stability, while an uncertainty-calibrated distillation mechanism reweights teacher guidance using online latent-model uncertainty, emphasizing uncertain regimes during learning, with time-to-collision (TTC) and clearance cues remaining explicit in planning and local policy features. To demonstrate the efficacy of the framework, a reproducible multi-seed evaluation protocol is established in high-fidelity GPU-accelerated simulation using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, and performance is benchmarked against BT-only and standard RL baselines. The results obtained demonstrate improved robustness and safety under dynamic conditions, thus providing a general pipeline with a unified hybrid planning learning architecture and a reproducible methodology for robust UUV autonomy under partial observability.

</details>


### [184] [World-to-Wrist: Task-Conditioned Future Wrist Modeling for Fine-Grained Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05369)
*Yuhao Pan,Haosong Peng,Zhengshen Zhang,Zhengyang Yan,Yalun Dai,Fushuo Huo,Chujie Wang,Tianyu Qi,Xiucheng Wang,Nan Cheng,Wenchao Xu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出W2-VLA，一种面向精细机器人操作的视觉-语言-动作模型，通过任务条件化的未来手腕建模来区分主视与腕视观测的不同作用，并在多个基准和真实任务上实现了性能提升，同时保持80Hz以上的动作生成速率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有的VLA模型通常将主视角和腕视角观测视为并行的视觉输入，忽略了它们在机器人操作中的不同角色。对于精细操作任务，感知手腕局部交互在全局任务上下文下如何演化至关重要，而现有方法未能利用这一点。

Method: W2-VLA将一组潜建模token作为视觉语言模型与手腕预测器之间的紧凑接口。给定当前多视角观测和任务指令，模型通过该接口并结合观测到的手腕历史，预测未来的手腕潜表示，并将其转化为未来感知上下文用于动作预测。同时引入W2-CoT合成流水线，生成包含操作进展、物理转换线索和手腕局部证据的结构化标注，以辅助监督塑造任务条件化潜接口。

Result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0和真实世界操作任务上的实验表明，W2-VLA在单臂和双臂设置下均提升了精细和接触敏感操作的能力，同时保持了80Hz以上的动作生成速率。

Conclusion: 通过显式建模手腕局部的未来演化并充分利用任务条件化信息，W2-VLA有效解决了传统VLA模型忽略多视角角色差异的问题，为精细机器人操作提供了更优的解决方案，且在实际应用中保持了高效的推理速度。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models often treat main-view and wrist-view observations as parallel visual inputs, overlooking their distinct roles in robot manipulation. Fine-grained manipulation, however, benefits from anticipating how wrist-local interactions may evolve under the global task context. To address this limitation, we present World-to-Wrist VLA (W2-VLA), a VLA model for fine-grained robot manipulation with task-conditioned future wrist modeling. Given current multi-view observations and a task instruction, W2-VLA contextualizes a set of latent modeling tokens as a compact interface between the vision-language model and the wrist predictor. Conditioned on this interface and the observed wrist history, the predictor forecasts future wrist latents, which are transformed into future-aware context for action prediction. In addition, we introduce W2-CoT, a synthesis pipeline that produces structured annotations describing manipulation progress, physical transition cues, and wrist-local evidence. These annotations provide auxiliary supervision that shapes the task-conditioned latent interface. Experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate improved fine-grained and contact-sensitive manipulation across both single-arm and bimanual settings, while maintaining action-generation rates above 80 Hz.

</details>


### [185] [Sliding Sensors: Configurable Confidence in State Estimation for Continuum Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05410)
*Ella Walsh,Spencer Teetaert,Eric Diller,Timothy D. Barfoot,Jessica Burgner-Kahrs*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种机械可重构传感方案，通过在连续体机器人内部纵向平移传感器，实现对状态估计不确定性的主动塑形，相比固定尖端传感器可降低整体形状估计误差。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 连续体机器人常在不确知环境中工作，需要准确的状态估计。但估计不确定性在空间上是非均匀分布的——不同位置的置信度因测量可用性而异。全局估计精度并非总是首要目标，关键在于任务相关位置处要获得足够的置信度。现有固定传感器方案无法适应这种空间非均匀的置信度需求。

Method: 提出机械可重构传感概念：设计了一种可在连续体机器人内部纵向滑动传感器的硬件概念，通过改变传感器位置来重新配置状态估计的置信度分布，并在时间上滑动传感器以覆盖不同空间区域。

Result: 实验证明：状态估计置信度可通过改变传感器位置进行重新配置；与单一固定尖端传感器相比，随时间往复滑动传感器的方案显著降低了连续体机器人的全身形状估计误差。

Conclusion: 机械可重构传感为连续体机器人的不确定性塑形提供了可行途径，是对传统固定传感器配置的有效改进，能够根据任务需求动态调整估计置信度分布。

Abstract: Continuum robots often operate in uncertain environments, where accurate state estimation is essential for safe interactions. Estimate uncertainty is inherently spatially non-uniform: confidence varies depending on where measurements are available. Global estimation accuracy is not always the top priority, but rather achieving sufficient confidence at task-relevant locations along the robot. This extended abstract introduces mechanically reconfigurable sensing enabling uncertainty-shaping in state estimation for continuum robots. We present a concept hardware design demonstrating the feasibility of longitudinal translation of a sensor within a continuum robot. We demonstrate that state estimation confidence can be reconfigured by varying the sensor location, and show a reduction of full-body shape estimation errors when sliding the sensor back and forth over time, compared to a single fixed tip sensor.

</details>


### [186] [ARGUS: Aligning Robot Scene Geometry Under Shifting Views with Large 3D Vision Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05579)
*Rishik Sathua,Haonan Chen,Katherine Driggs-Campbell*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ARGUS是一个观测预处理管道，利用大规模3D视觉模型将任意相机视角的图像观测对齐到标准视角，再传递给下游视觉运动策略，从而解耦场景几何与观测视角之间的纠缠，提升策略从视角多样化数据集学习的能力和泛化性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模视觉运动策略虽然在多种机器人操作任务上表现优异，但往往将场景几何与观测视角纠缠在一起——策略学到的是图像中物体的位置而非任务空间中的位置。这种纠缠限制了策略从视角多样化的数据集（如DROID、BridgeV2）中学习的能力，也难以泛化到训练数据未覆盖的视角。

Method: 提出ARGUS，一种观测预处理管道，利用大规模3D视觉模型将来自任意相机视角的图像观测对齐到统一的规范视角，然后再将对齐后的观测传递给下游视觉运动策略进行训练和推理。

Result: 在从固定多视角相机配置到高度多样化相机布置的不同视角多样性训练数据集上，ARGUS一致优于先前方法；在效率对比中，ARGUS通过利用简化的观测空间，收敛到高成功率的训练速度比先前方法快4-6倍。

Conclusion: 利用大规模3D视觉模型可以减轻视觉运动策略的学习负担，使其能够更高效地从大规模、视角多样的机器人数据集中学习，验证了通过解耦视角与几何信息来提升策略泛化能力的有效性。

Abstract: Large-scale visuomotor policies have demonstrated impressive performance across a wide range of robot manipulation tasks. However, despite this success, manipulation polices often entangle scene geometry with the corresponding viewpoint, learning where objects lie in an image rather than where it lies in the task space. This entanglement inherently limits the corresponding policy's ability to learn from viewpoint-diverse datasets (ex. DROID, BridgeV2) and generalize beyond the viewpoints captured in their training data. In this work, we present ARGUS, an observation pre-processing pipeline that uses large-scale 3D vision models to align image observations from arbitrary camera viewpoints into a canonical viewpoint before passing it to downstream visuomotor policies. Experiments across training datasets with varying levels of viewpoint diversity, from fixed multi-view camera configurations to highly varied camera placements, show that our method consistently outperforms prior approaches across both limited-view and view-diverse training regimes. In efficiency comparisons, ARGUS demonstrates an ability to learn from view-diverse data, converging to high success rates 4-6x faster than previous methods by leveraging a simplified observation space. Overall, our findings show that leveraging large-scale 3D vision models reduces the learning burden on visuomotor policies, enabling more efficient learning from large-scale, viewpoint-diverse robot datasets.

</details>


### [187] [PathCover: A Fast Convex Decomposition along a Path via Randomized Iterative Space Partitioning (RISP) on Point Clouds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05586)
*Kunal S. Narkhede,Abhijeet M. Kulkarni,Guoquan Huang,Ioannis Poulakakis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PathCover是一个由RISP随机算法驱动的自主机器人导航框架，从原始点云数据中直接构建凸多面体走廊（序列），在期望线性时间内生成无碰撞区域，相较现有方法实现一个数量级的加速，并在仿真和真实机器上得到验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主机器人导航需要快速生成无障碍区域用于轨迹规划，但现有走廊生成器难以满足实时、传感器频率级别的计算约束，这成为轨迹规划的瓶颈。

Method: 提出PathCover框架，核心是RISP——一种新型随机化算法，在温和的概率消除条件下以期望线性时间直接从原始点云数据构建凸多面体。PathCover生成重叠的无障碍多面体序列，用于约束MPC和轨迹优化。

Result: 在合成和真实LiDAR数据集上进行广泛基准测试，相比最先进方法实现一个数量级的加速，同时保持相当的走廊体积。通过高保真四旋翼仿真和四足机器人物理部署（使用实时LiDAR感知）验证了完整流程。

Conclusion: PathCover提供了一种满足实时计算约束的走廊生成方案，论文数学保证了算法在有限步内终止并沿任意无障碍参考路径持续进展，证明其在受限环境下的实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Autonomous robot navigation requires the rapid generation of obstacle-free regions for trajectory planning. However, existing corridor generators struggle to meet real-time, sensor-rate computational constraints. To resolve this bottleneck, we introduce PathCover, a framework driven by RISP; a novel randomized algorithm that constructs convex polytopes directly from raw point cloud data in expected linear time under a mild probabilistic elimination condition. PathCover generates sequences of overlapping, obstacle-free polytopes that safely constrain downstream MPC and trajectory optimization. We mathematically guarantee that the algorithm terminates in finite steps while ensuring continuous progress along any obstacle-free reference path. Extensive benchmarks on synthetic and real-world LiDAR datasets demonstrate an order-of-magnitude speedup over state-of-the-art methods while maintaining comparable corridor volumes. The complete pipeline is validated via high-fidelity quadrotor simulations and physical deployment on a quadrupedal robot navigating constrained environments using live LiDAR perception.

</details>


### [188] [Search-Aided Joint Agent-Environment Reinforcement Learning for Robust Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding with Rotations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2608.05588)
*He Jiang,Jingtian Yan,Yulun Zhang,Yimin Tang,Tanishq Duhan,Rishi Veerapaneni,Guillaume Sartoretti,Jiaoyang Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出LMAPF-R2模型，引入鲁棒安全约束和原地旋转约束以更贴近真实仓库场景，并提出搜索辅助联合强化学习（SJRL）方法，通过Causal PIBT单步搜索增强神经策略，并联合优化智能体与环境策略以提供全局移动指导。实验在多个高密度地图及混合现实仓库环境（8台物理机器人+248台虚拟机器人）中验证了SJRL对Causal-PIBT基线的显著改进。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有学习型LMAPF规划器大多基于过度简化的运动学假设，忽略了真实系统中关键的运动约束（如鲁棒安全约束和原地旋转约束），导致在复杂高密度环境中协调困难且实际部署性能受限。

Method: 提出Search-Aided Joint Reinforcement Learning (SJRL)：1) 将神经策略与Causal PIBT（单步搜索规划器）结合，用于解决碰撞并传播智能体意图；2) 引入统一的强化学习框架，联合优化智能体策略与环境策略，其中环境策略学习图边成本，通过反向Dijkstra搜索提供全局移动指导；3) 在当前目标达成后持续接收新目标，实现终身规划。

Result: SJRL在多个高密度地图上相比强搜索基线Causal-PIBT取得显著性能提升，并在包含8台物理机器人和248台虚拟机器人的混合现实仓库环境中得到进一步验证。

Conclusion: 通过将搜索机制与联合强化学习相结合，SJRL能够有效处理带有鲁棒安全和原地旋转约束的LMAPF-R2问题，在真实约束下实现优于纯搜索基线的多智能体路径规划性能，验证了学习与搜索混合方法的实际可行性。

Abstract: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding (LMAPF) requires repeatedly planning collision-free paths for agents that continuously receive new goals upon reaching their current ones. While many learning-based planners have been proposed for LMAPF, most rely on oversimplified kinematic assumptions that may overlook motion constraints critical to real-world performance. In this work, we study a more realistic LMAPF model derived from many real-world automated warehouse systems, termed LMAPF-R2, which incorporates robust safety constraints and in-place rotation constraints. These constraints substantially increase coordination difficulty, particularly in highly constrained spaces. To address these challenges, we propose Search-Aided Joint Reinforcement Learning (SJRL). We first augment neural policies with Causal PIBT, a single-step search-based planner that resolves agents' collisions and propagates their intentions.
